# Contract: `search_knowledge` agent tool (sc-114)

Registered as `KB_TOOLS = ToolGroup("Stored knowledge", (search_knowledge,))` in
`backend/app/agent_tools/kb_tools.py`, added to `extra_groups` in `agent_runner._get_runner`.

## Arguments (JSON schema generated by ADK from the signature)

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `queries` | `list[str]`, 1–5 | each 1–300 chars with at least one letter or digit; phrasings run concurrently |
| `kind` | enum `wcl` \| `guide` \| `chat` | hard |
| `class_name` | enum of roster classes (`Warrior`, `DeathKnight`, …) | soft unless stated |
| `spec` | enum of roster specs (`Arms`, `BeastMastery`, …) | soft unless stated; alone = every class with it |
| `encounter` | string (name or id) | resolved; soft unless stated |
| `difficulty` | enum `LFR` \| `Normal` \| `Heroic` \| `Mythic` \| `Mythic+` | never relaxed |
| `report_code` | string `^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}$` | hard; implies kind `wcl` (guide/chat with it is an error) |
| `character` | string (name or `Name-Realm`) | resolved against the workspace; never relaxed |
| `since`, `until` | ISO date or datetime (UTC) | soft unless stated; relaxed together |
| `k` | int 1–15, default 8 | |
| `user_stated` | list of enum `class_name, spec, encounter, dates` | filters the user stated explicitly (hard) |

The workspace comes only from `current_identity` (checked against the ADK session user).

## Result

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "mode": "hybrid",
  "relaxed": ["spec"],
  "capped": false,
  "note": null,
  "hits": [
    {"kind": "wcl", "source": {"report_code": "BKNtypgnhrxXvj84", "fight_id": 32, "label": "fight 32 Damage done"},
     "text": "Report BKNtypgnhrxXvj84, fight 32, Heroic Ula'tek, kill, 535 s. Damage done: …", "score": 0.0325},
    {"kind": "guide", "source": {"class_name": "Warrior", "spec": "Arms", "content_type": "raid", "section": "Rotation"},
     "text": "…", "score": 0.0161, "relaxed": true},
    {"kind": "chat", "source": {"conversation_id": "…", "message_seq": 4}, "text": "…", "score": 0.0159}
  ]
}
```

- `mode` is `keyword_only` when the query embedder is unavailable or failed; `note` then says
  so in one sentence the agent can repeat.
- `hits` empty with `status: success` only when nothing matched after every allowed relaxation;
  `note` says no stored knowledge matched and suggests the Warcraft Logs tools.
- Serialised result ≤ 6,000 characters; `capped: true` when hits were dropped for it.

## Errors (plain tool errors, the turn goes on)

| Case | `error_message` |
|---|---|
| outside an authenticated chat turn | `Knowledge search is unavailable in this session.` |
| resolver error | the `ResolutionError` text, e.g. `Unknown encounter "ulatk". Close matches: Ula'tek.` |
| bad argument (queries, report code, dates, k) | which argument and the allowed form |
| database error / timeout / not Postgres | `Knowledge search failed; use the Warcraft Logs tools.` |

## Internal API (for the eval and tests)

```python
async def search(request: SearchRequest, *, mode: Literal["hybrid", "vector", "keyword"] = "hybrid",
                 embedder: Embedder | None = ...) -> SearchResult
def fuse(per_query: Sequence[Sequence[Candidate]]) -> list[ScoredSource]      # pure, RRF twice + dedupe
def cap(result: SearchResult, limit: int = 6000) -> SearchResult              # pure
```
